claim: Every OBPI brief is a structural artifact whose Allowed Paths, Discovery Checklist, Verification commands, REQ-IDs, and citation tuples MUST reconcile against current project shape before Stage 2 implementation begins. Drift is fail-closed at gz obpi pipeline Stage 1 (refuses Stage 2 entry without a fresh reconciliation receipt) and at gz obpi complete Stage 5 (refuses completion without a reconciliation receipt newer than the most recent mutation in the brief's allowlist domain).
